title: Morning rush in Vienna: every bus and tram, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Vienna, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus and tram inside the city on an average October weekday. VOR's regional buses also run in Vienna but are not in the feed, so they are not shown.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Vienna city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Bus, Tram and Badner Bahn.

Busiest moment of the morning: 966 vehicles at 7:36 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out National Day (October 26). Wiener Linien changed its timetables during October, so its weekday uses one typical date.
